messages:
Noah (Finance): billing-bot flagged higher-than-usual GPU line items tied to 'demo-rigs' across ap-southeast and eu-west yesterday. see vendor export: https://vendor.storage/invoices/18700-demo.csv cc @Priya @Jorge
billing-bot: ALERT: scope=demo-rigs period=2026-04-05 gpu_cost=32,450usd delta=+145% vs 14d avg. top_projects=[demo-showcase,partner-demos,roadshow]
Priya (FinOps): ouch. need to know which are customer-facing vs internal. can we map instance labels to customer ids?
Jorge (Cloud Ops): pulling allocation logs. quick root cause: deployment script used `--disk-persist=true` for ephemeral demo images in two releases (2026-04-04). machines didn't auto-terminate after demo end and ended up running for 12-36h. PR that introduced it: https://git.redwood/cloud/merge/7888
Amir (Sales): if partner demos were affected we can't bill them. please flag partner-demos immediately; I'll notify partners once we confirm amounts
Priya (FinOps): export sample (anonymized):
```
project,resource,cost_usd,labels
demo-showcase,res-a1,7,200,customer=;owner=demo-team;tag=roadshow
partner-demos,res-b2,11,800,customer=partner-omega;owner=;tag=partner-demo
roadshow,res-c3,3,950,customer=event-2026;owner=events-team;tag=roadshow
```
Noah (Finance): proposal: 1) provisional credits for any resource with customer tag present 2) internal chargeback for owner-less demo rigs after backfill attempt 3) add runbook step to confirm teardown after demos
Jorge (Cloud Ops): running 72h backfill on owner metadata now. also adding immediate deny rule for images with label `demo-ephemeral=false`. deploy in 5m: https://git.redwood/cloud/changes/7891
billing-bot: ACTION: budget_alert created project=demo-showcase threshold=75% recipients=[noah@redwood.com,priya@redwood.com]
Priya (FinOps): approved provisional credits for partner-demos up to $12k pending Amir confirmation. I'll prepare allocation table for finance review in 2 hours
Amir (Sales): I'll confirm partner charge expectations in 30m. if they're impacted we'll absorb and credit 100%
Jorge (Cloud Ops): backfill finished: 68% owner tags restored. unknown pool = $6,100. posted CSV: https://cloud.ops/reports/demo-backfill-1870001111.csv
Noah (Finance): finance will absorb unknown pool this month and track for reclamation if owners surface claims within 14 days. Priya, finalize credits and I'll post invoice adjustments. thanks :white_check_mark:
